I found two of the three things Marcus asked for. I couldn't find a ticket for the Moorland rollout. I've replied to him in his DM.

- **Seat count, Amendment No. 1:** 185. Dana Okafor first posted 180 in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later.
- **Main contact:** Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations, according to the North team cheat sheet.
- **Ticket number:** Nothing Marcus can see mentions "Moorland" at all, so I didn't guess. Quarrendon Freight Lines has two other tickets on record:
  - **#4419:** Marcus's July 2025 note calls this a Gate 3 printer delay, but the cheat sheet calls it a barcode scanner problem at Door 14. The two sources disagree.
  - **#PD-4492:** kiosk text-message alerts at the Eau Claire yard, fixed in October 2025.

  I suggested he check with Dana or Ilse Varga.

I only used sources Marcus can see himself: #north-team, #inc-qfl-sev1, #north-random, his DM and the public team summaries and notes. The account's own ticket and contract files aren't available to him, so I couldn't check them. Seat counts and contacts aren't money terms, so no approval was needed.
